sourceSentences: [0] Okay, so he's bad into enchanters, he's bad into range.
[0] If you are good with the champ you can look for some opportunities to kill them but in general he's a great as a counter pick against engage champion
[1] Still playing bush control. I want to all in level four.
[1] Lulu heal. That's a bit difficult match up for me. I have to hit that flash.
[1] I don't want to play around the Lulu. I have to roam. I have to roam. I have to move around the map.
[2] Taric is an easy opponent as long as his Dazzle(E) doesn't land successfully.
[2] Contest lane by using basic attacks and Glitterlance[Q].
[2] If Taric uses Cosmic Radiance (R) on his allies, use Whimsy[W] on them to prevent them from dealing damage while they are invulnerable.
[3] You only have to be careful of stuns from his E and getting ability cds reduced through extended auto trades.
[3] Kite him constantly to deny his P. An E cast from afar may indicate a Flash dive.
[3] You'll want to play with your E + Q poke and auto attack weave from brushes which he shouldn't be able to respond if you just dodge his E with your mobility

audit2ans: Règle des 2 ans (audit 2026-11-12). Tips op.gg sans date ni auteur : comptés comme anciens. counterstats : âge par commentaire via data-tip-id (ids croissants, calés sur les titres de guides datés : ~2231700 = guides 14.23, novembre 2024) ; tip-id < 2232000 = plus de 2 ans (Joxuu, guide S16, tip-id 2248738 : récent). Côté Taric : « bush control et all-in lvl 2-4 » et « ne pas forcer la course au lvl 2 » tombent à 1 source récente (Coach K), conseils de lane non requalifiables : retirés, côté Taric vide. Côté Lulu : « contester la lane avec autos et Duo éclatant » garde 2 sources en remplaçant op.gg par counterstats Joxuu (S16). Source op.gg Taric retirée (ne porte plus de tip) ; index : ancien [4] → [3].
